name: Yukari
source:
Emi's acquaintance who attends a university, an 'older sister' girl. She met Emi during her vacation on summer vacation at her parents' house.

[spoiler]After graduation she work at hospital in Tokyo as nurse and care for Jouichi while he admit in her hospital.
She retired from work to assist Jouichi 's rehabilitation at his home​ before move to Kyushu with Kana.
